business_summary: Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation, a specialty finance company, engages in the originating and investing in commercial real estate (CRE) loans and related investments in the United States. The company provides loan opportunities for the owners, operators, and sponsors of CRE properties. Its investments includes senior mortgage loans, subordinate debt, preferred equity products, mezzanine loans, and other CRE investments, such as commercial mortgage-backed securities. It has elected and qualified to be taxed as a real estate investment trust for the United States federal income tax purposes under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986. Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation was incorporated in 2011 and is based in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: 전문 금융 회사인 Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation은 미국에서 상업용 부동산(CRE) 대출 및 관련 투자를 창출하고 투자하는 데 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 CRE 부동산의 소유자, 운영자 및 후원자에게 대출 기회를 제공합니다. 투자에는 선순위 모기지 대출, 후순위 채권, 우선주 상품, 메자닌 대출 및 상업용 모기지 담보 증권과 같은 기타 CRE 투자가 포함됩니다. Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation은 2011년에 설립되었으며 뉴욕주 뉴욕에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
